annotations.title: FINRA TRACE Secondary Debt Tape & Single-CUSIP Collar Structuring

description: Retrieves secondary-market FINRA TRACE dealer execution metrics (last clean price % of par, Z-spread over 10Y U.S. Treasury in bps, effective yield-to-worst %, dealer bid-ask spread in bps, and daily institutional block volume in USD) and solves a Black-Scholes zero-cost 1-year European option collar (put floor strike % and call cap strike %) for a single bond CUSIP or ticker. Use when: inspecting secondary-market dealer liquidity/spreads or structuring a zero-cost downside put / upside call collar for a single bond issue. Do not use when: calculating exact cashflow duration/convexity/DV01 for a custom face value (use get_cusip_valuation instead), or stress-testing a multi-bond portfolio across macro rate shocks (use run_portfolio_stress_test instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic market tape and option solver ($0.50 USD per call via HTTP header x-api-key or x-payment-token; returns an x402/MPP paymentChallenge without charging if credentials are omitted).

benchmark_ust_yield.description: Reference 10-Year U.S. Treasury constant-maturity yield as a percentage used for spread and risk-free collar pricing (e.g., 4.15 for 4.15%; default: 4.15).

cusip.description: 9-character CUSIP identifier to query on the secondary debt tape (e.g., "912828ZG2", "037833EK1", "38141GZX8"; default: "912828ZG2").

ticker.description: Issuer ticker symbol to resolve if CUSIP is not specified (e.g., "RWA-AERO", "AAPL", "GS"; default: "RWA-AERO").

name: get_debt_radar

collar_structuring.description: Zero-cost 1-year European option collar strikes (% of par) solved via Black-Scholes.

downside_floor_strike_pct.description: Protective put floor strike as a percentage of par.

net_upfront_premium_usd.description: Net upfront premium in USD (0.00 for zero-cost collar).

upside_cap_strike_pct.description: Covered call cap strike written to fund the put, as % of par.

issuer_name.description: Legal name of the bond issuer.

receipt.description: Cryptographic payment or API key settlement receipt ID.

tape.description: FINRA TRACE secondary market execution and liquidity metrics.

bid_ask_spread_bps.description: Dealer round-trip bid-ask liquidity spread in basis points.

daily_reported_volume_usd.description: 24-hour reported institutional par volume in USD.

last_clean_price.description: Most recent institutional print clean price as % of par.

secondary_spread_bps.description: Credit spread over benchmark U.S. Treasury in basis points.

title: FINRA TRACE Secondary Debt Tape & Single-CUSIP Collar Structuring
